about: Every provider here must expose an Anthropic Messages-compatible endpoint, because a worker is a headless Claude Code session pointed at it with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (Claude Code appends /v1/messages). status: verified = a full worker run succeeded; endpoint-checked = URL and auth shape confirmed with an invalid key plus the provider docs, no worker run; documented = provider docs only.

ollama-cloud.label: Ollama Cloud (ollama.com)
ollama-cloud.notes: Build, test and review workers ran end to end on the Nebula project. Pick a cloud model that supports tools.

ollama-local.label: Ollama on this machine
ollama-local.notes: No key, no per-token cost, code never leaves the machine. Set model to a locally pulled model that supports tools; quality is whatever that model gives.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter
openrouter.notes: The base URL has no /v1 (that path is the OpenAI-style API). The Anthropic endpoint reads the key from x-api-key or Authorization. Catalog price on 2026-11-25 for the default model: about 0.15 USD in and 0.60 USD out per million tokens; other cheap models: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash, z-ai/glm-5.3-flash, qwen/qwen3-coder-flash.

deepseek.label: DeepSeek API (direct)
deepseek.notes: Model names must be DeepSeek's own (deepseek-flash, deepseek-v4-pro, optionally with a [1m] suffix); names that do not start with claude and are unknown return 400. Both x-api-key and Authorization are accepted.

zai.label: Z.ai (GLM)
zai.notes: Endpoint answers 401 on an invalid key. Set model to a GLM model from the Z.ai docs.

moonshot.label: Moonshot (Kimi)
moonshot.notes: Endpoint answers 401 on an invalid key. Set model to a Kimi model from the Moonshot docs.

custom.label: Any Anthropic-compatible gateway
custom.notes: LiteLLM, claude-code-router, a company proxy, or any provider that speaks the Anthropic Messages API. Set base_url, key_env and model in .crew/config.json.
